title: SAED (Windfall Tax) Rates Revised on Fuel Exports from October 31, 2026
content:
# SAED (Windfall Tax) Rates Revised on Fuel Exports from October 31, 2026

Ek important update hai! Government ne crude petroleum, diesel, aur Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) exports par Special Additional Excise Duty (SAED) ya windfall tax rates revise kiye hain. Yeh changes October 31, 2026 se effective ho gaye hain.

**Key Revisions:**

*   **Petrol Exports:** SAED has been reduced to **Nil** (earlier ₹2.50 per litre).
*   **Diesel Exports:** SAED has been increased to **₹11.50 per litre** (from ₹8.50 per litre).
*   **ATF Exports:** SAED has been marginally increased to **₹11 per litre** (from ₹10.50 per litre).
*   **Effective Date:** These revised rates apply to export clearances made on or after **October 31, 2026**.
*   **Domestic Prices:** Important baat yeh hai ki domestic petrol aur diesel prices par in changes ka koi asar nahi hoga.
*   **Notifications:** These changes were brought in through Notification No. 55/2026-Central Excise (G.S.R. 963(E)) and Notification No. 56/2026-Central Excise (G.S.R. 964(E)), both dated October 31, 2026.
